mentions.name: Allspeak
mentions.description: A set of complete programming systems in languages other than English, built with Claude Code. Each is a full scripting language in its own right rather than a wrapper around English syntax, with its own language pack plus documentation, tutorial, and programmer's playground, all sharing a common compiler and runtime and designed to be highly AI-friendly. Italian is the first language, with plans for others such as Polish and Bulgarian and an open call for collaborators.
mentions.problem: Programming languages are typically English-based, limiting who can program in their own language.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working with Claude Code to create complete programming systems in languages other than English. Not just wrappers around an English syntax;these are based on an English original but are complete scripting languages in their own right, with documentation, tutorial and programmer's playground.
